name: Exploratory GraphMAE telemetry variants
training_assignment: Window index modulo three chooses one fixed corrupted observation; no label-dependent selection.
objective: Common BCE plus Brier per-window loss, weighted by inverse capture frequency. CONS_GMAE adds 0.5 prediction MSE against detached original-view probabilities under extra 20% coordinate masking. Validation selection uses common BCE plus Brier only.
early_stopping: Mean validation objective across clean/missing20/spoof20 on capture9, no test access.
threshold: Maximize attack F1 on clean validation capture9; ties choose highest threshold. Fix it for every test condition.
primary: EDGE_GMAE minus GMAE clean macro attack AP
CONS_GMAE minus GMAE clean macro attack AP
bootstrap: 1,000 shared paired crossed seed/time-block draws; fixed captures with equal weights and 64-window blocks; exact weighted AP. Report 95% and 97.5% marginal percentile intervals for two planned contrasts. Bonferroni interpretation is approximate and conditional; results remain exploratory because the test captures were previously examined.
preprocessing: First six numeric/log features z-scored using observed training values, then clip5; ports scaled65535, binaryflags unchanged. All14 observation masks appended. No IP, absolute timestamp, row/scenario identifier or label field enters numeric features.
graph: Undirected endpoint-sharing graph inside each fixed chronological window, derived from observed source/destination identities; not a prerequisite implication graph. Host identities can recur across splits.
scope: Real captured university traffic with controlled botnet executions, not production incident ground truth. Primary endpoint is retrospective window-end flow classification, not operational COA success. Background/To-only labels excluded, so population is verified-label subset.
stress: Missingness independently masks14featurecoordinates. Spoofing independently replaces20/40percent observed first8numericcoordinates with training-verified-benign means; masks/graph unchanged. These are artificial telemetry manipulations on captured data, not measured adversarial deception.
novelty: Specific observed-coordinate gating and corruption-consistent telemetry adaptations of established graph-masked, robust-graph and consistency ideas; no first-ever architecture claim.
communication: No distributed serializer or network-link simulation in this external application; input tensor size and bounded host transfers are measured, not communication compression.

controls.CONS_PRE: Same two-view latent-consistency pretraining, zero supervised consistency

selection: No hyperparameter sweep. Constants fixed in code/configuration before new test inference. All 20 training and validation-threshold selections finish before any new held-out inference.
cost: Equal maximum epochs and optimizer-update schedules, not equal FLOPs: consistency uses additional forward passes and edge gating adds pairwise feature work. Imported baseline times are historical; a common-session audit remeasures costs.
test_reuse: Previously examined CTU-13 test outcomes motivated this follow-up. All new test comparisons are exploratory; fresh datasets or captures are needed for confirmation.
